title: erlangea tomentosa
intro: Erlangea tomentosa, commonly known as "hairy erlangea", is a plant species found in tropical Africa, characterized by its hairy leaves and stems. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Erlangea tomentosa include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The therapeutic actions of Erlangea tomentosa may help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and digestive issues, while also providing antioxidant and antimicrobial effects.
